headline: Extends the Congressional Award Board, the body that oversees the Congressional Award youth program, through fiscal year 2023.
what_it_does: This law amends the Congressional Award Act to keep the Congressional Award Board in operation through fiscal year 2023. The Board oversees the Congressional Award, a program that recognizes young people for personal development efforts. The summary does not describe changes to the program's requirements or funding amounts.

who_it_affects.group: Young people who take part in the Congressional Award program
who_it_affects.how: The program they participate in is allowed to keep operating through fiscal year 2023 under this law.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Congressional Award Board
who_it_affects.how: The Board's authority to carry out its duties is extended through fiscal year 2023.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted October 11, 2018, with the reauthorization running through fiscal year 2023.
